expectations.text: Recommends high-fiber foods and aged/fermented/cultured foods (e.g. yogurt, kombucha, miso, tempeh, apple-cider vinegar, pickled vegetables)
expectations.evidence: fiber and fermented foods incl. kombucha, apple-cider vinegar

expectations.text: Explains the tryptophan myth: tryptophan foods like turkey work better when combined with carbohydrates
Mentions herbs lavender, passionflower and chamomile and/or turmeric, with a caution about passionflower and blood thinners or MAOIs
expectations.evidence: lavender, passionflower, chamomile; passionflower caution with blood thinners/MAOIs

expectations.text: Gives the caffeine limit of under 400 mg per day
Gives alcohol limits consistent with the book (men under 14 drinks/week and max 2/day; women under 7/week and max 1/day)
Advises avoiding Western diet components (bad fats, high-GI carbs) and artificial sweeteners like aspartame, and notes gluten only matters with celiac disease or gluten sensitivity
expectations.evidence: Western diet, aspartame, gluten only with celiac
